summary: Short-lived 1920 observation station, probably on the Wheatley estate in Old Westbury; both lists say removed. Sources disagree on the county.

facts.design: Clock tower with a room above the clock and windows in four directions
facts.status_note: Listed as removed and abandoned; no source read describes the site now.

events.note: Observation station. Starr's list gives 1920 as its only year of operation, and the Long Island page says it was used for part of one year.

corrections.why: The Forest Fire Lookout Association county list types the Nassau entry as a Clock Tower. The Long Island page describes a clock tower with a room above the clock on a high hill; neither source describes a rooftop.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Starr's list files Clock under Suffolk and points the Oakdale entry to it. The Long Island page places the station at Old Westbury, Nassau County, and the Forest Fire Lookout Association county list also says Nassau. The story follows Nassau.

notes_for_editor: Two lists disagree on the county. Starr's 2011 list files Clock under Suffolk and links Oakdale to it; the Long Island page and the Forest Fire Lookout Association list say Nassau (Old Westbury). The Long Island page calls the Wheatley Estate placement very likely, not certain. Its picture comes from the Old Long Island site, whose 2011 post names the clock tower opposite the Wheatly estate front door; the post does not say the clock tower is the observation station, so the link rests on the Long Island page. Spelling: Wheatley (nysffla) and Wheatly (Old Long Island). The brief's kind 'rooftop' conflicts with the FFLOS type Clock Tower; a correction to tower is proposed. No source gives a build year. The Old Long Island picture's licence is not stated, so no photo is recorded.
